apps.name: VoltTune
apps.subtitle: Scooter tuning via Bluetooth
apps.versionDescription: Tab navigation, firmware flashing, region change, panic button, 89 models, detailed scooter illustrations, safe speed limits per model.
apps.localizedDescription:
VoltTune connects to your electric scooter via Bluetooth and unlocks its full potential.

• Remove speed limits
• Sport Mode & Zero Start
• Eco Mode & Cruise Control
• Firmware flashing (SHFW + Stock)
• Region change (EU/US/UK/DE/FR/NL/INT)
• Panic Button
• Lock & Alarm
• Controller & firmware info
• 89 supported models

For use on private property only.

permissions.usageDescription: VoltTune uses Bluetooth to connect to your scooter.
